questions.q: A transformer has 1000 turns on the primary and 50 turns on the secondary. The primary voltage is 230 V. What is the secondary voltage?
questions.why: Vs = Vp × Ns ÷ Np = 230 × 50 ÷ 1000 = 11.5 V (a step-down transformer).

questions.q: A magnet is pushed into a coil connected to a meter. Which change would NOT increase the induced e.m.f.?
options: using a coil with more turns
questions.why: Pulling the magnet out only reverses the direction of the e.m.f.; speed, field strength and turns change its size.

questions.q: Why is electricity transmitted over long distances at a very high voltage?
options: the current is larger so more power is delivered
high voltage makes the cables cooler by itself
transformers only work at high voltage
the current is smaller so less power is lost as heat in the cables
questions.why: For the same power, high V means low I, and power loss P = I²R is much smaller.
